notes:
## New features

- Save a replayable diagnostic from a contour-generation error, including an unsaved scene, its calculated grid and the runtime versions.
- Prepare interpolated and SmartSmooth views in the background after calculating the raw grid. Switching presentation or editing bands reuses the calculated result.
- Cancel contour presentation work from the footer while retaining the previous display.

## Changes

- Verification scope: focused source tests and native workflow checks; no complete regression-suite pass or new standards-compliance certification is claimed. Earlier failed and crashed test runs are retained separately from subsequent passing checks. The original unsaved failing scene was unavailable for exact-case verification.
- macOS distribution uses the existing ad-hoc signing channel; this installer is not Developer-ID signed or Apple-notarized.

- Reuse the same interpolated field and screening transitions across band intervals, ranges and colours. Cache face tracing data and scalar checks, and batch shared-edge matching to reduce repeated work.
- Apply simplification and curve-strength changes off the UI thread. Superseded slider results are discarded, and repeated selections reuse completed geometry.
- Show measured progress through contour preparation, threshold extraction and shared-edge shaping. Completion is reported after the requested presentation is displayed.
- Dense, uncached layouts can still take several seconds: the P1999 40-band, 1 dB native check took approximately eight seconds. Ordinary band changes and slider updates were faster; these timings are not a guarantee for every model or computer.
- Record and verify the actual source inputs during macOS builds, including uncommitted changes, alongside the resolved runtime versions.

## Bug fixes

- Fix a fresh-project interpolation failure caused by a fixed-precision union in the triangle coverage audit. The replacement audit preserves mesh coordinates and existing acceptance tolerances, and still rejects gaps, overlaps and triangles outside the domain.
- Retain the previous valid contour display when a new presentation fails, with an actionable error instead of an uncaught callback traceback.
- Remove cosmetic graphics-effect allocation from popup and button-polish callbacks and the editor drop-import overlay implicated in Qt crashes.
- Keep presentation worker threads alive until native cleanup completes when their tab is closed or deleted.
